summary: Start date is one of the terms that can be bargained along with pay and leave.
realLife: A career office notes that start dates, leave and benefits can be negotiated with salary, and the agreed start date should be restated in the written acceptance.
sources: UW-Madison SuccessWorks, accepting and negotiating your offer: https://successworks.wisc.edu/accepting-and-negotiating-your-offer/
inGame: Tenure begins at the job record's start date; the start date slot can be set when a person is hired.
